title: sentinel-lint configuration
description: Configuration for the .sentinelrc.json file read by sentinel-lint.

failOn.description: Lowest severity that makes the CLI exit with code 1.

include.description: When non-empty, only paths matching one of these globs are scanned.

exclude.description: Paths matching one of these globs are skipped.

rules.description: Per rule severity overrides. The value off disables the rule.

plugins.description: Rule modules to load, resolved relative to this file.

trustedActions.description: Third-party action owner or repository path prefixes trusted by actions/unpinned-action. Use sparingly; a full commit SHA is stronger.

trustedNonRootImages.description: Exact image repositories or namespace prefixes ending in a slash with a documented non-root tag contract trusted by container/missing-non-root-user. Docker tags remain case sensitive, and a digest-bearing reference is never exempted by tag inference.

trustedArtifactOnlyScratchStages.description: Exact Dockerfile stage names explicitly trusted as artifact-only final scratch exports. The stage must still contain only file-transfer or metadata instructions and at least one cross-stage COPY proven through a numeric earlier-stage index.

trustedActionsLockEnforcement.description: Operator policy for trusting .github/workflows/actions.lock when the repository host is known to enforce locked workflow dependencies. A true value in a config file inside the scan root is ignored with a warning; use a config file outside the scan root or the scan API. Keep false unless that external enforcement has been verified.

maxFileSize.description: Files larger than this many bytes are skipped.

maxFiles.description: Stop the walk after this many readable text files.
